purpose: Make the named Part I cast visibly alive now while establishing a safe skeletal-rig handoff path. Runtime prefers an imported skeletal mesh plus locomotion AnimBP only when both exist; otherwise the project-owned modular character remains active with deterministic low-cost procedural idle/walk/talk motion.

rig_contract.activation_rule: Both skeletal mesh and AnimBP class must resolve before modular visuals are hidden.
rig_contract.fallback_rule: If either rig asset is missing, keep modular production meshes visible and animate their parts procedurally.

procedural_profiles.notes: Shorter, quicker steps with warm visible idle breathing.
Balanced locomotion for Rangers, Men and Bree adults.
Quieter body motion and smoother gait.
Heavier arm/leg swing with reduced upper-body sway.
Measured gait and restrained idle motion.

performance_rules: Do not tick a second skeletal/procedural visual path at the same time.
Keep locomotion math allocation-free and bounded per character.
Dialogue gestures reuse the existing dialogue acting timer instead of spawning timeline actors.
Companion catch-up remains capped and teleports only beyond the existing safety distance.
Final skeletal/facial/cloth acceptance requires UE4.27 import, PIE and target-device evidence.
Use distance-based animation update throttling/URO for non-hero skeletal actors once final skeletal rigs are active.
Keep standard locomotion in-place; root motion is not the default traversal system.

locomotion_policy.root_motion_scope: Core traversal and companion locomotion remain in-place/code-driven. Root motion is reserved for bounded cinematic or attack montages only when explicitly justified and validated.
locomotion_policy.anim_blueprint_reuse: Do not duplicate locomotion logic per character. Keep the current per-character asset resolution contract, but prefer a shared humanoid locomotion base/logic with thin character-specific wrappers or data overrides when skeleton compatibility allows.
locomotion_policy.skeletal_performance: Before increasing simultaneous skeletal crowds, enable distance-based animation LOD / Update Rate Optimization for non-hero actors and verify target-device behavior.
